name: 30k
closure_reason: Data quality and coverage goals met. Corpus expanded to 155K wines (3x target) via LWIN long-tail sweep in Session 13. Enrichment pipeline validated for Grade B in Session 12. Architecture pivoting to Reference-First enrichment in Sprint 2 — wine-level Grade C synthesis deprecated in favor of enriching the shared reference layer (grapes / regions / appellations / producers) and treating wine pages as thin synthesis over that context.
goal: Quality-over-coverage rebuild of the wine corpus. Archive 477K-wine pre-rebuild dataset, rebuild cleanly from LWIN backbone + TTB depth + targeted importer promotion. Target: ~30K high-quality wines with working enrichment.
